summary.headline: The Magi and the Star of Christ
summary.text: Continuation of an apologetic discussion of the Magi, arguing that the star and its zodiacal sign revealed Christ’s divine birth rather than ordinary astrological calculation. It cites Mosaic law, Ptolemy’s astrological teaching, Matthew’s account of the Magi, Pseudo-Basil’s homily on Christ’s birth, and Balaam’s prophecy.
